sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 7XL.
Ignores 50% of the target's DEF and MDEF (cannot be stacked).
Increases damage when using a physical or magic attack Ability by M+.
Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%.)
Ability Power scales with the number of Time elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 7XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate scales with the number of Time elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
